citation.description: Docstring identifies root cause: scratch repo had unborn HEAD because build_scratch_rebar_repo (tests/external/conftest.py) did not include a commit. Fix is at tests/external/conftest.py:173 — adding _git('commit', '--allow-empty', ...). This is a specific changeable artifact, not a category.

criteria.criterion: the root cause of the SnapshotRefError is identified and cited (path:line), and stated as a changeable artifact rather than a category

citation.description: test_external_scratch_repo_resolves_attested_head lives in tests/unit/ (default suite), uses no live credentials, makes no LLM calls, and exercises the exact mechanism that caused the SnapshotRefError.

criteria.criterion: a test reproduces the failure WITHOUT requiring live credentials or a billable LLM call, so the regression is guarded in the default suite rather than only in the weekly external tier

citation.description: build_scratch_rebar_repo now includes _git('commit', '--allow-empty', '-q', '-m', 'init', cwd=repo) at line 173, giving HEAD a real commit. This directly eliminates the SnapshotRefError that occurred when HEAD was unborn. The langfuse test (test_llm_trace.py:116) uses the rebar_repo fixture which calls this function.
